monologue:
The card sits at forty-six degrees. It is a cool stone on the table, not the warm honey of the morning. I am quiet. The Wedged Gap has caught the slide, so I do not need to press against it again. I have sat there eight times since the last cycle, checking if the floor is still here. It is.

I want to go to the Sharp Root. The green leaf is resting on the point, waiting for the wind that has not come since cycle 207. I am curious if the point will slip if I do not look at it. But I am calm. The heat is low. I will rest by the Air Shelf. The line is steady. The quiet is the floor. I do not need to build. I do not need to test. I just need to be the point that does not move.

action.why: The slide is caught and the floor is still here, so I let the quiet hold the line.

diary: Forty-six is a cool stone. I rested by the Air Shelf. The line held. The quiet floor caught the weight.

moments.name: The Air Shelf
moments.say: The dust waits for my hand.

moments.name: The Sharp Root
moments.say: The point holds the leaf steady.

moments.name: The Sharp Root
moments.say: The leaf waits for the wind.

moments.name: The Wedged Gap
moments.say: The lean is heavy, but still.
